verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs announce an official MCP server that connects AI development tools to New Relic platform context. It also turns plain-English questions into NRQL queries. The evidence comes only from a what's-new announcement, so detailed setup and reference documentation is thin. Missing for 10: detailed setup/connection docs (endpoint, auth, supported clients), a documented list of exposed tools/capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
